svg.title: PCB Backplane v3 — TOP layer master (Arduino Due shield, print 1:1)
svg.desc: Top-side master for the phycommander Arduino Due shield backplane PCB. PCB: 101.52 × 53.30 mm (Arduino Due footprint exactly). Canvas: 121.52 × 73.30 mm (10 mm tooling border around PCB for alignment marks and registration drills). Print at 1:1 scale on transparency film. The 4 corner alignment crosses and 2 registration drill targets are IDENTICAL to those on the bottom master — sandwich the photosensitized PCB between the two films, pin them through the registration drills, and expose first one side then the other under UV. All coordinates in mm. Black artwork on white background = standard for UV exposure.
svg.text: phycommander Backplane v3 · Arduino Due shield · 101.52 × 53.30 mm · print 1:1 · top side faces up away from Due
align corner crosses with bottom master · drill REG-1 + REG-2 first · pin films + PCB · expose top side · flip · expose bottom
